equations.u1_mixing_control: beta_i = g_i * sum_j B_ij*g_j^2/(16*pi^2), B positive semidefinite

gravity_abelian_control.conclusion: A nonzero root exists for positive background coefficient A, but it is UV-repulsive in this ansatz; the UV-attractive root is Gaussian.

multi_u1_mixing_control.conclusion: For the positive-semidefinite normalized controls, the nonnegative fixed point is Gaussian; physical charge assignments and full kinetic-mixing RGEs are not specified.

reduced_standard_model.conclusion: The reduced one-loop Standard Model control has no non-Gaussian real perturbative fixed point.

fixed_points.interpretation: only real perturbative fixed point of this reduced one-loop polynomial control
